about.heading: Boutique Salesforce shop, enterprise-grade delivery
body: Stratus Hub partners with small and mid-size businesses that need more from Salesforce than out-of-the-box configuration. We combine certified platform expertise with practical business consulting — so your CRM, marketing automation, and custom code actually match how you sell and serve customers.
Whether you need a greenfield implementation, a rescue project, or ongoing development capacity, we work as an extension of your team — responsive, collaborative, and focused on outcomes.
